description: Canon guard: protects the author's anchored decisions, keeps each novelsmith agent writing only its own files under book/, and keeps subagents' shell, MCP and other tools off the book. It runs on every tool call and returns at once for anything but a file write or a subagent's call. Stays silent (allows the call) where python3 or the script is unavailable, including macOS's python3 placeholder before the developer tools are installed, so it never blocks writing; /novelsmith:doctor reports whether it is active.

hooks.command: [ "$(command -v python3)" = /usr/bin/python3 ] && [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && ! xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; python3 -V >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard-canon.py" ] || exit 0; python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard-canon.py"
